# ex: implicit dereference in selector (applySubst implicit * path)
ex {
	var p *T
	p.X -> p.X + 1
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func F(t T) int {
	return t.X
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 type T struct{ X int }

 func F(t T) int {
-	return t.X
+	return t.X + 1
 }
